snippet.title: This is Not an Escape (Interactive Choose Your Own Adventure Game)
snippet.description:
The story begins here. 
Simply click on the video link to travel through the adventure. Annotations no longer work on Youtube, so some puzzles will no longer work. I hope you enjoy!

This game was made for the JayIsGames websites Casual Gameplay competition and won Second Place.
Second Place in Jayisgames.com's Casual Gameplay Design Competition #10
